metrics.name: extra checkout p50 from the hop on a normal day
slow recs: orders per second, monolith
slow recs: orders per second, split
crash-loop recs: orders per second, monolith
crash-loop recs: orders per second, split

conclusion: In this toy shop the split cost about 2.6 ms extra checkout latency on a normal day, but when recommendations slowed to 2 s checkout errors were 97.5% in the monolith versus 0.0% split, and in a crash loop 98.7% versus 0.0%.
setup: virtual-clock simulation, seed 19, 200 req/s Poisson, mix checkout/search/recs 0.2/0.4/0.4, base service time 20/10/15 ms (uniform 0.5x to 1.5x, 3% of calls x3, so expected mean 21.2/10.6/15.9 ms), 16 workers total (monolith 1x16, split 4/6/6), simulated hop 0.8 to 1.6 ms each way + 0.2 ms gateway, client timeout 1000 ms, 20 s per scenario (first 2 s not counted), slow recs 2000 ms, crash after 50 ms with 2000 ms restart, redeploy at 8 s: monolith restart 4000 ms vs one service 1500 ms; hop, gateway and restart durations are assumed inputs, the metrics are their simulated effect on checkout
